title: 高二十五题：镜头与市场
source_form_notice: 高二另一普通阶段卷五材料2/3/3/4/3已核，不能由既有三材料十题替代；源录音/脚本/听力键缺，原校认证未建立。源逐段声音角色未独立听核，本稿4对话1独白为允许的本机实现，不冒称源原录音角色全已核。本稿完整原创配套非gold或独立难度验证。
teacher_source_notice: 高二另一普通阶段卷五材料2/3/3/4/3已核，不能由既有三材料十题替代；源录音/脚本/听力键缺，原校认证未建立。源逐段声音角色未独立听核，本稿4对话1独白为允许的本机实现，不冒称源原录音角色全已核。本稿完整原创配套非gold或独立难度验证。
source_scoring_notice: 该源节15题、每题1.5分，共22.5分。每段两遍，听前听后每题5秒；间隔一秒与重播提示属本机编排。
format_summary: 5材料 / 2+3+3+4+3共15回应 / 三选 / 每段2遍 / 本稿4对话1独白（源逐段角色未独立核证）
instruction: 听全部五段材料，按2题、3题、3题、4题、3题的顺序完成全部15题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听前、听后各按每题5秒留时。审阅可重播，非正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Your camera photographs have a dark spot in the same place. Is the lens scratched?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I thought that too, but the spot disappeared after I cleaned the filter in front of it. The lens itself is fine.

questions.rationale: A：原猜测被清洁结果否定；B：未说屏坏；C：清滤镜后消失

questions.stem: What is true of the lens now?
questions.rationale: A：不需换；B：明确镜头没问题；C：未出售

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The market stall fee is thirty pounds for the day. If we share a stall, we can split that.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I would like to, but my prints need a flat table. Your hanging plants could drip on them.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can put the plants on the ground beside the table, on a waterproof tray.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That might work. Let us ask the organiser whether we may use the space beside it.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will call her this afternoon before we pay.

questions.stem: How much would each person pay if they split the fee equally?
questions.rationale: A：30平分为15；B：总费非每人；C：把总费翻倍

options: The stall is too far away.
questions.rationale: A：没担心客流；B：没谈距离；C：植物滴水会伤画

questions.stem: What will they do before paying?
options: Check the use of nearby space.
questions.rationale: A：先不买桌；B：明确向组织者问旁边空间许可；C：未取消卖植物

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Have you finished editing the walking-tour recording?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Almost. I removed the traffic noise between stops, but left some footsteps in.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Why keep those?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: They help listeners sense the movement through the town. If every pause is completely silent, the recording feels like separate lectures.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That makes sense. Did you keep the bell at the old crossing?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, but made it quieter so it would not cover the guide's voice.

questions.rationale: A：保留导游声音；B：明确去除站间交通噪声；C：留了部分脚步

options: To create a sense of movement.
questions.rationale: A：目的非凑时长；B：未掩错；C：明确让人感到穿行城镇

options: It was moved to the end.
questions.rationale: A：调低避免盖人声；B：没换音乐；C：没挪结尾

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Our school wants to compare energy use before and after the new windows were fitted. I have the monthly bills.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Be careful. Last winter was much colder than this one. A lower bill would not by itself prove the windows caused the change.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: So I should compare the outdoor temperatures too?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes, and the number of days the building was used. It was closed for an extra week this year.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can get temperature records from the local station. The caretaker has the opening dates.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good. Also compare energy units, not just money. The price per unit changed in January.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Then the report should describe the limits rather than promise an exact saving.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Exactly. You can still show the evidence and explain what remains uncertain.

options: The effect of new windows on energy use.
questions.rationale: A：非食堂项目；B：明确换窗前后能耗；C：非教室面积

questions.stem: Why might this year's bill be lower for another reason?
questions.rationale: A：还少开一周不是更多；B：价格变化不等免费；C：上冬更冷、今冬较暖

questions.stem: Who has the building's opening dates?
questions.rationale: A：明确caretaker；B：未由厂家保管；C：气象方提供温度

questions.stem: Why compare energy units rather than money alone?
questions.rationale: A：不是账单缺日期；B：一月单价改变；C：没说窗户发电

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: The community language exchange will try a new arrangement next month. Previously, everyone joined one large conversation group. Confident speakers enjoyed it, but several beginners said they rarely had a chance to speak. We will now use pairs for the first twenty minutes, before returning to a larger group. Each pair will receive two simple topic cards. They are prompts, not a test, and you may change the topic if you wish. Please arrive ten minutes before the session starts so we can make the pairs. The exchange remains free. If you can help translate the welcome notice into another language, leave your name with the organiser. We are asking for volunteers for that task, not for paid lessons or formal examinations.

options: Beginners had too little chance to speak.
questions.rationale: A：无拆房；B：熟练者原本喜欢；C：初学者反馈机会少

questions.stem: What will happen in the first twenty minutes?
questions.rationale: A：明确先两人交流；B：卡片不是考试；C：活动免费非付费讲座
A：不卖备考书；B：明确翻译欢迎告示志愿任务；C：明确非付费授课
